rotating.title: Rotating
rotating.remarks: Specifies if the item is a rotating item.

serialnum.title: Serial
serialnum.remarks: Serial number of the rotating item.

lastupdatedate.title: Last Update Date
lastupdatedate.remarks: Date the count book was updated.

hasphyscnt.title: Has Physical Count
hasphyscnt.remarks: The attribute used for the OSLC Query.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.remarks: Accuracy of the physical count versus the current balance for this item, expressed as a percentage. A value more than 100% indicates an overcount. Count Books can only accept accuracy values of 999.99% or less. If the count variance is greater, you must go to Inventory and manually adjust the value.

gldebitaccount.title: GL Debit Account
gldebitaccount.remarks: The GL debit account for the storeroom. This is the account that is debited when a current balance adjustment occurs.

adjphyscnt.title: Adjusted Balance
adjphyscnt.remarks: Adjusted physical balance for the item. This is the quantity of the item in the storeroom. Maximo calculates this by adding receipts and transfers in, and subtracting issues and transfers out, that occurred after the physical count.

physcntby.title: Counted By
physcntby.remarks: User who performed the physical count.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Asset number of the rotating item.

curbal.title: Current Balance
curbal.remarks: Current balance of the item. Maximo refreshes this value when you enter a physical count and the count book status is COMPLETE.

lastupdateby.title: Last Update By
lastupdateby.remarks: Last user to update the count book.

recon.title: Reconcile
recon.remarks: Check box that specifies if the count for this item is approved for reconciliation. If the check box is selected for a non-rotating item, Maximo sets the current balance equal to the adjusted physical balance when the count book is completed.

conditioncode.title: Condition Code
conditioncode.remarks: Condition code associated with the item. A condition code lets you track the balance and value of each item. You can apply different rates to an item as its condition changes from use, such as from new to used. If you mark an item as condition enabled, you must assign at least one condition code to it. For each condition-enabled item, one condition code must have a ''''full-value'''' rate of 100%. Maximo uses this condition code as the reference point to calculate values for any other condition codes for this item. Each time you issue, transfer, or return the item, you specify the condition of the item based on codes that you set up. To specify a condition code, click the Detail Menu button. To create a condition code, use the Condition Codes application.

errorvalue.title: Error Value
errorvalue.remarks: Discrepancy between the current balance and the adjusted physical count. A positive value represents an overcount. A negative value represents an undercount.

match.title: Match
match.remarks: Check box that specifies if the item count matches the current balance value, within the specified tolerances. For example, the current balance value is 100, and the plus and minus tolerances are set at 3%. If  the actual count is 102, that is a ''''match.'''' A count of 104 or 96 would not be a match.

tool.title: Is Tool
tool.remarks: Check box that specifies whether the item is a tool.

physcntdate.title: Count Date
physcntdate.remarks: Date and time that the physical count occurred.

glcreditaccount.title: GL Credit Account
glcreditaccount.remarks: GL credit account for the storeroom. This is the account that is credited when a current balance adjustment occurs.

nextphycntdate.title: Next Count Date
nextphycntdate.remarks: Date and time that the physical count is scheduled.
